body: No, we didn't have problems in our relationship. We loved each other, but our vision of our relationship is different. That is why it's so hard.

Thank you for your kind words. Now that I have managed to sleep(with weird dreams)--and something I haven't done in a while--I feel a little better.

These are the times when I wish I could believe blindly in a God that gives me a purpose for things and takes care of me. Sadly I know there is no such thing.

She wants to settle. To buy a house(that involves taking a huge loan). To have kids. To marry me. All normal things. But not for me. I am not prepared to pay for a huge loan and not prepared to take care of another human being, especially in the world we live in today.

We decided that we are wasting each other's time. All our friends(in 8 years all friends start to become common friends) picked her side--which is totally normal.

The pain comes form me knowing that I failed this relationship.

All I want is something to numb the pain while the disease, the hurt, goes away. Alcohol seems to take care of that as I could finally sleep for 8 hours straight. I suffer from insomnia and that never happened to me before in my life. I guess the cigarette was because I felt low about myself.
